game_title: Door Defense – Dragon Hoard Cave Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the crystal door while the while-loop condition stays true and rock golems keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Push to repair the crystal door while the while-loop condition stays true and rock golems keep attacking. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the door_health value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the crystal door using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the crystal door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 18.
